# `network/routes/RouteTable.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/routes/RouteTable.js`

network/routes/RouteTable.js — dynamic, capability-gated routes for the Particle Global OS Network Layer (network plan §9 "dynamic routes instead of rooms" + §10 capability checks).  A route is NOT server-owned: it exists in this local table only while a capability-holding principal has attached to it and kept its lease alive via heartbeats. There is no createRoute() — attachRoute() both creates the local entry (if absent) and joins it. Leases expire on their own; nothing here talks to a network — this is pure local bookkeeping that the Masterserver signaling tier (Phase 2b) and per-route session manager below will drive.

## Functions

### `createRouteTable(cfg = {})`

Create an empty route table.

**Parameters:**

- `[cfg]` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[cfg.selfPeerId]` *(string)* — this device/session's peer id (for convenience defaults)

**Returns:** route table state

### `attachRoute(table, { routeId, principal, capability, ttlMs = DEFAULT_ROUTE_TTL_MS, meta = {} } = {})`

Attach to a route. Validates the capability authorizes `route/attach` for (principal, routeId) right now; if the route doesn't exist locally yet it is created (this is what "routes appear when clients attach" means — there is no separate creation step). Re-attaching refreshes the lease.

**Parameters:**

- `table` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `req` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `req.routeId` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `req.principal` *(string)* — the attaching signer's fingerprint
- `req.capability` *(object)* — from makeRouteCapability()/attenuateRouteCapability()
- `[req.ttlMs]` *(number)* — lease duration (default DEFAULT_ROUTE_TTL_MS)
- `[req.meta]` *(object)* — opaque local metadata (routeType, maxFanout, maxHops, ...)

**Returns:** }

### `heartbeatRoute(table, { routeId, principal, ttlMs = DEFAULT_ROUTE_TTL_MS } = {})`

Refresh a principal's lease on a route (heartbeat). Re-checks the capability so a revoked capability cannot keep renewing its lease.

**Returns:** }

### `detachRoute(table, { routeId, principal } = {})`

Detach a principal from a route. Removes the route entirely once empty.

### `pruneExpiredRoutes(table, now = _now()`

Remove all expired subscriber leases (and any routes left with zero subscribers). Call this periodically (e.g. alongside heartbeat ticks).

**Returns:** >} removed leases

### `isRouteAttached(table, routeId)`

True if `routeId` currently has at least one live subscriber.

### `getRoute(table, routeId)`

Snapshot of a route's subscribers, or null.

### `listRoutes(table)`

List all currently-live routes (opaque summaries only — no capability objects).

## Constants

- `DEFAULT_ROUTE_TTL_MS` — Default route lease TTL (network plan §9/§35: ~90s).
- `DEFAULT_HEARTBEAT_MS` — Default heartbeat interval to keep a lease alive (network plan §8: 25-30s).
